title: nan
authors: Di Y.; Jiang C.; Li C.; Wang X.; Su Z.; Chen S.; Liu Z.; Wu X.; Chen Y.
key_contribution: Presents AS-VPS, combining front-end SuperPoint+LightGlue visual odometry, back-end aerial-to-satellite image matching, and factor graph optimization (FGO) for UAV localization without GNSS.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Optimization_Based_VIO to ensure precise positioning.
